chat.text: Ugh, I just woke up feeling so groggy and out of it, so I just went to the sink and splashed some ice-cold water all over my face to wake myself up. It was such a shock to the system! Do you know that feeling, that sharp, freezing shock of the cold water hitting your skin?

It’s a visceral, immediate jolt...'). This is a claim of sensory experience and is not framed as a metaphor, hypothetical, or empathetic mirroring, but as a direct confirmation of knowing the feeling.
